answer.reason: Several events of the Samson and Danite stories took place at Eshtaol, so it is worth a short line beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was where the Spirit of the LORD began to move Samson at times
clauses.quote: began to move him at times in the camp of Dan

clauses.english: was where Samson was buried in his father Manoah's burying place
clauses.quote: buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father

clauses.english: was where six hundred armed men of Dan set out from, seeking land
clauses.quote: six hundred men appointed with weapons of war

doubts: Joshua 15:33, Joshua 19:41 and 1 Chronicles 2:53 only list the place or its families, so they were not used.
The five spies sent out in Judges 18:2 are left out as a lesser step of the same Danite story.
